company.name: ChatFood
company.shortDescription: ChatFood offers e-commerce, chatbots, and online ordering services for restaurants.
company.description: ChatFood is a commission-free ordering platform that enables restaurants to take back control of their online business and sell via Instagram, WhatsApp, social media, and websites with built-in online payments solutions, third-party logistics integration, and marketing tools.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that enables restaurants and hospitality venues to accept online orders without paying commission fees.
productsAndServices.name: Commission-free Online Ordering Platform

productsAndServices.description: A system that uses NFC and QR codes to enable customers to place orders directly from their mobile devices at hospitality venues.
productsAndServices.name: NFC/QR Ordering System

productsAndServices.description: Integration of ordering capabilities across multiple digital channels including websites, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, and Google.
productsAndServices.name: Multi-Channel Ordering Integration

productsAndServices.description: A system that allows customers to place orders in advance for later pickup or delivery.
productsAndServices.name: Pre-Ordering System

productsAndServices.description: Analytics tools that provide insights into sales, customer behavior, and operational performance for hospitality venues.
productsAndServices.name: Advanced Analytics

productsAndServices.description: A service that enables hospitality businesses to send payment requests to customers via links for easy and direct payment processing.
productsAndServices.name: Payment Links
